chunks.text: I’m heading out of Beijing and over to Shanghai for a work thing, so I’ve been thinking through that whole Beijing-to-Shanghai flight plan.
After that, I’m swinging by Nanjing for a few days, so I’ve been picturing where I’ll stay once I’m in the city.
For the Beijing to Shanghai leg, it’s that China Eastern flight MU5890 on 2026-04-08, and it’s under Mike Davis.
In Nanjing I’m staying at the Sofitel Nanjing Galaxy; check-in is 2026-05-21 and it’s for 4 nights.
Oh, and the Nanjing hotel is under Ma Liang—now I’m just thinking about how tight the timing feels between everything and whether I’ll even have time to grab dinner when I land…
